observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function _merge_predicate_ops that generates parenthesised, NULL-safe predicates using IS NOT DISTINCT FROM, replacing bare equality predicates.
observations.posthog_connection: This fixes a silent data corruption and duplicate accumulation in warehouse ingestion. The warehouse connector uses delta-rs to merge source and target tables; without this, rows with NULLs in composite keys never match and are re-inserted every incremental sync, silently growing the warehouse table.

observations.behavior: Replaces the predicate construction with the new helper, switching from bare equality to the NULL-safe, parenthesised form.
observations.posthog_connection: This is the implementation change that applies the fix to the warehouse ingestion pipeline. It changes the predicate used by delta-rs to ensure rows with NULLs in composite keys are correctly matched and updated rather than duplicated.
